title: Recent advances in Alzheimer's disease: From molecular mechanisms to therapeutic strategies.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Ran paper_context.py: the abstract says it is a review. Europe PMC lists no supplement (hasSuppl=N, and the supplementaryFiles call returned a 297-byte non-zip). NCBI links point only to PMC records. The text-mined accessions are only clinical-trial IDs (NCT numbers) and DOIs of cited papers. There are no GEO/SRA/Zenodo/Dryad hits. The full-text request returned HTTP 500.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The abstract alone describes a narrative review of APOE (apolipoprotein E) biology, neuroimmunology, biomarkers and anti-amyloid therapies. It reports no new data.

a1_downloadable.note: A review article with no deposited dataset or supplement (checked via Europe PMC and NCBI links). Only cited trial IDs, which point to registry entries, not data tables.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No data table exists, so no label column. Any label would have to be assembled from the cited studies.

a3_inputs_present.note: No inputs present; the review only cites other work.

honest_claim_h3: None possible: this review provides no data to model.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use patient biomarker measurements to predict Alzheimer's progression. The idea was considered and dropped because this review has no data.
plain_idea.train_on: Nothing in this paper. The data would have to come from the cited cohorts or trials (count unknown).
plain_idea.predict: Cognitive decline or amyloid status. No measured labels are supplied here.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Clinicians choosing who gets anti-amyloid therapy would benefit, but the data lives in other, often controlled-access, cohorts and not in this paper.

ml_idea: None from this paper. A future project would need a primary dataset, e.g. a plasma biomarker cohort, which typically needs an access application.

effort.compute_note: No data, so nothing to estimate.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Check for a supplement or data deposit. Done: there is none.

verdict_reason: This is a narrative review with no deposited data or supplement. It only cites clinical-trial IDs and other papers, so there is nothing to download or model (fails A1 and A2).
